response.rationale: C1 and R2 share the same decisive raw spans: CT shows ascending colon wall thickening with exudative changes, and ascites culture grows E. coli, directly supporting infectious colitis. C1 adds anatomical (ascending colon) and etiological (E. coli) specificity, making it more complete. R8 has only non-specific abdominal pain/tenderness without imaging or culture support. R6 has elevated CRP/PCT but these are non-specific and not paired with a clear source. R7 relies on leukocytopenia but lacks neutropenia (ANC not low). R1, R3, R4 have no raw support spans. Thus C1 is champion, R2 runner-up.
